description: Opens dBase and FoxPro .dbf tables and .dbc databases from chat links, with their memo and index files, and no FoxPro, ODBC or Windows. Agents in the thread can list the tables and run read-only queries on them, so their answers come from the files. A .dbc brings every table it names, with long names, primary keys and relations drawn as an ER diagram. The files are read in the panel and never uploaded. Exporting the diagram, or more than 10,000 rows of a result, needs DBConvert PRO ($9 a month).
